name: Futsuki
source:
The most elegant and regal of the sisters. Futsuki is well versed in the ways of the royal life but doesn't know much about the outside world. She secretly yearns for the freedom of living outside the palace. 

from [url=/https://kavorkaplay.com/post/190518096089/hanapon-princess]Kavorka[/url]
